answer.rationale: The establishment is recordkeeping-covered, and the case is stated to be a new, work-related fatality. Death satisfies the general recording criteria. The employer must report the fatality to OSHA within 8 hours, enter the recordable case on the OSHA 300 Log and OSHA 301 Incident Report within 7 calendar days of receiving information of the case, and retain the specified records for 5 years following the end of the covered calendar year.
